cells.gaps: Sources disagree on standing: Jones Day (2025-06-30) says passed, not yet promulgated; TechHive (2025-11-05) says enacted in June 2025 but gives no promulgation or commencement date. No regulations, application or last-twelve-months event held; the CNDP is not stated to be constituted.
cells.note: Enacted is the strongest standing stated, and enactment alone places no higher than 3. Stage 4 needs in-force standing and a dated decision under the law, none found.
